data.summary: 目前 source-backed reproduction：在 G2 尚未核准時，configured extension-package 的 argv 可通過 guard 的 exact argv 比對而不檢查 writes:tracked-artifact、phase、release context、canonical cwd 或 trusted executable；在已綁定且 G2 後，非 read-only、非 configured、非 Wiki 的 arbitrary side-effect Bash 會落到 allow。此結果與 P0 要求的 G2 前 Deny 與 G2 後 ad-hoc 預設拒絕不符。

Reproduction executed successfully against current source: before G2, configured extension-package (writes:tracked-artifact) is admitted by argv-only matching without phase/release/cwd/executable policy; after G2, an unregistered side-effect Bash falls through to allow. The reproduced observed behavior is a failure against the requested P0 policy.

data.reason: Expand the existing Guard bug into the unified Verification Policy, Effective Verification Plan, evidence eligibility, configured-executor, profile/G3 consistency, write reconciliation, and policy mutation stale contract requested by the current high-risk bug scope.

data.rationale: Single Policy Evaluator, frozen Effective Verification Plan, digest-bound eligibility, controlled configured-command execution, strict cross-shell read-only grammar, policy mutation stale, staged write safety, Doctor/contracts, regression tests, baseline and planned Wiki updates; extension outputs remain verification artifacts rather than product logic scope.

data.summary: BUG-01 temporary Guard payload matrix: shell operator, command substitution, backtick, Git output flag, unknown Git flag, CMD environment expansion, and PowerShell expression payloads returned allow; only the pre-existing double-operator and basic redirection cases denied.

BUG-02 temporary configured-command harness: pre-G2 exact configured write command denied, but post-G2 exact configured write/release/output command allowed; wrong cwd payload allowed and direct Bash had no DevWeave executor handoff.

BUG-03 temporary drift harness: after passing evidence for one command, changing its argv left stale=false and the raw G3 current-evidence filter true; old and new command definitions were not digest-bound.
BUG-04 temporary expectation harness: exit 7 with expect nonzero and exit 0 with expect any both produced status=passed and entered the raw G3 current-evidence set; gate_eligible was absent.

BUG-05 temporary profile harness: selective standard runner selected none and skipped release-only, legacy, unrelated, and release-dependent commands, while G3 reconstructed all four from the project required set.

BUG-06 temporary concurrency harness: writer and writes-none test were submitted in the same batch without dependency or exclusive group; test observed the pre-build state and failed while writer later passed.
BUG-07 temporary output-boundary harness: command declared dist output but modified src; exit 0 still produced passed evidence, with no actual_changed_paths or undeclared-write violation.
